title: Potassium & the ECG

findings.title: Opening the explainer loses keyboard focus
findings.problem: Activating Watch removes the focused button. start() scrolls the section into view but never focuses its replacement. tabIndex={-1} does not focus the section automatically, so keyboard focus is lost and the section’s arrow-key handler is no longer reachable from the current focus position.
findings.fix: After the player renders, explicitly focus its heading or section with preventScroll, then perform the intended scroll. Verify that keyboard users can immediately navigate and pause playback.

findings.where: Images 6 and 13, step hyper-care; src/explainer.jsx, go()
findings.title: A tall step can leave the following explanation offscreen
findings.problem: hyper-care requires substantial vertical scrolling at phone width. Its controls are below the long caption, but go() changes steps without restoring the reading position. In a rationale page with content below the player, advancing from that scrolled position can leave the next step’s diagram above the viewport. Live scroll anchoring in the containing app could not be verified from the supplied material.
findings.fix: Restore focus and reading position to the new step’s heading when navigating, honoring reduced-motion preferences. Split hyper-care into shorter assessment/protect/shift/remove steps instead of presenting the entire emergency-care explanation as one caption.

findings.where: Images 1, 4, 8 and 11; hypo-care caption/narration; HYPO_IV; hypokalemia dynamicCaption
findings.title: The displayed replacement check drops “adequate”
findings.problem: Fact 8 requires adequate urine output, but the checklist, caption, narration and worked-example branch merely require urine output to be confirmed. Some urine being present is not equivalent to adequate output; the abbreviated wording weakens the stated safety check.
findings.fix: Use “confirm adequate urine output” consistently in the checklist, captions, narration, accessible description and dynamic hypokalemia caption.

assessment: Revise the player’s focus/navigation behavior and the replacement precheck wording.
